candidates.angle: The word Protam literally means strung
The word Parataram literally means higher
Krishna says nothing exists higher than him

en.intro: After explaining the two natures, Krishna now asks Arjuna to see the whole world in one image. Listen for the single word that holds the universe together.
en.notice: Notice the word protam, meaning strung. The entire world is not just near him, it is woven through him like beads on a thread, held in place only by that single line.
en.next: Krishna then lists his form in the elements, the syllables, and the qualities of human beings.
en.meaning: O Dhananjaya, nothing exists higher than Me. All this world is strung on Me like pearls on a thread.

hi.intro: दो प्रकृतियों की बात के बाद, कृष्ण अब अर्जुन को एक चित्र में पूरी दुनिया देखने को कहते हैं। उस एक शब्द को सुनिए जो पूरे ब्रह्मांड को एक साथ बाँधता है।
hi.meaning: हे धनञ्जय, मेरे बढ़कर इस जगत् का दूसरा कोई किञ्चिन्मात्र भी कारण नहीं है। जैसे सूतकी मणियाँ सूतके धागे में पिरोयी हुई होती हैं, ऐसे ही यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् मेरे में ही ओतप्रोत है।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर तत्वों, अक्षरों और मनुष्यों के गुणों में अपने स्वरूप की बात करते हैं।

en.intro: After explaining the two natures, Krishna now asks Arjuna to see the whole world in one image. Listen for the single word that holds the universe together.
en.body: O Dhananjaya, nothing exists higher than Me. All this world is strung on Me like pearls on a thread. Notice the word protam, meaning strung. The entire world is not just near him, it is woven through him like beads on a thread, held in place only by that single line. Krishna then lists his form in the elements, the syllables, and the qualities of human beings.
